## R1 — original conversation preview readiness before one UI click, 2026-11-16

### Current failure and retained evidence
Original PR1213 Installer job133187479786 on frozen E3e41e39b101ccc06bb24203be245ac55dcf1502f failed in desktop-ui-controls.ts325 through selection-ui.ts146/176. The retained exact expected tuple is [169.5,178,'BUTTON']; the final original read returned [169.5,186.5,'BUTTON']. No mousePressed or mouseReleased followed that refusal. The last original hover had the user's TEST_UI_BOOT preview; the later screenshot shows the TEST boot ready reply. BOOT had already completed in the captured native peer before openChat; proof.a is assigned afterward, so its absent milestone does not mean launch never ran.
The same source's original Selection lane passed. This is a timing-sensitive admission hypothesis tied to the actual target preview, not proof of an exclusive underlying rendering cause. Retain the failed Installer result. Its overall verifier also failed; final remainingCount0, app exit0, peerAbsent=true and acknowledged Quit/listener absence are retained separately, with capturedHostAbsent still null.
Complete raw8067cbf218e21c147fde958bfc732b0c0ce82f30 and original receipt8bb2d3a0777ddcd84818ef507274f1923e5f4ab6 are embedded. Root verified original artifact14214905147:289816bytes/SHA38169713084fff9a0eabf3efa97671b8819107a94c12076325128e8c77512826, ZIP CRC and16 safe unique members, and visually inspected original screenshot SHAe9c77c7b28126d6ccf896efa47fa9181eeed3b0b3425bad1402f28a40f44a326. The screenshot is later evidence, not an atomic DOM sample of the failed final read.

### Current baseline and dormant diagnostic scope
Publish on own branch fix/frontend-parity-coobservation-c714-20261115 with exact parent5e41fd21b03d67a1ac965096f693e9931185405c/tree4aa3019c406ece7a799289a4312394efadc791f8. All8798 non-document source leaves remain frozen E; local HEAD47d9f29602bae778f20ae8cc133ca332e458e59a has exactly the prior17 source overlays. Do not check out another actor's delivery72e6 source.
The prior Driver.close diagnostic R1 remains a retained, dormant proposal. Original current E embedded Linux job133187477178 really passed its unchanged credential gate: four original Host exits0/null signal/stdout-valid, cleanup=true, three credentials, requests[refused,OK,OK,timeout] and cold unverified intent/no-replay. Original M failure and its unknown inner close phase remain historical. Root original seven-member artifact package8d82c2a10a4ced6660461f2bbc5ae45ab29d225e is embedded; independent full raw/source/artifact closure is1fcff4956035da94565487bbd9b20a7a7784a98c. No diagnostic producer, app test, runner, source export, install, RED/GREEN or package check was performed. Its only authored candidate is unselected bare D test8d7ef8cd44084fd99d3d068720b4c261312ace1c; it has no R2 or branch application and is not selected by this R1. No D source or package pin changes are admitted here.

### Exact source scope
Only three listed100644 preimages may change: controls1e94339df46ef3bb963555fc3cc7253055766a78, selectiondcd0cc29a73a46a24126ec3552714fa1b057aaf4 and whole test3e5d5a5a765b503943bd72f68b2877311ee34479.
Controls may add at most20 physical lines for a backward-compatible optional fourth data argument requiredContent?:string to ui.click and the corresponding optional argument to its existing private target-expression builder. It is data serialized exclusively with desktopJsLiteral, not a new arbitrary execution hook. Only after the unchanged positive-size/exact-text eligibility and unique-row cardinality decision may the exact selected element's textContent be required to include this literal. Two matching eligible rows must still be unavailable even when only one contains the marker. An unmet marker returns the existing unavailable-target shape with matches:1; never raw content or a neighboring/body match. With requiredContent undefined, the generated original target expression must be byte-identical, and all default calls keep their existing behavior.
Keep the entire existing clickExpression/readPoint, Page.bringToFront, original scrollTo, hover, ownership checks, final direct expression evaluation/unavailable guard/exact[x,y,tag] equality, mousePressed/mouseReleased pair and uncertainty behavior unchanged. The same complete target expression including the optional predicate must run on every original phase and final direct read, so readiness disappearing at unchanged coordinates refuses input. No retry after hover/click uncertainty, no mutation replay, no target substitution, no synthetic dispatch and no bypass of the final guard.
Selection may add at most10 physical lines: openChat(live,expectedReply) forwards that requiredContent as the fourth click argument while preserving its original selector and scroll. Existing calls176/260/267 use TEST boot ready; call285 uses TEST stream partial. Keep all existing post-click visible checks, the explicit absence of TEST stream partial complete, owner/native/currentness/census/session/input assertions, original replies, screenshot/milestone ordering and installer effects unchanged.
The whole existing2099-line test file is an exact byte prefix; append at most180 lines/24 runtime cases. No old case/assertion/export/import body is replaced. The producer source stays below800 lines; global5020 source count,141 exceptions and800 cap stay unchanged. No renderer/product/provider/native/workflow/ignore or source-size-exception change.

### Time and authority boundaries
Existing click behavior has a separate30000-ms waitRead deadline per readPoint phase, not one overall30-second click budget. This change only strengthens its original read predicate: add no waitRead, CDP call site, timer, delay, deadline reset, sampling call site or loop. The stronger predicate may use more polls and ownership checks within an existing readPoint loop and its unchanged deadline; total read counts are not asserted equal. Preserve100-ms cadence,15-sample ceiling and two stable comparisons. The separate75-second native-session poll and60-second visible-reply waits stay exact. Existing waitRead implementation and its current post-await behavior are not changed or newly qualified.
Readiness is only a TEST UI admission observation and grants no lifecycle, custody, currentness, native or vendor authority. Actual target movement or owner change at the final original guard still fails before physical click. A marker from a foreign row or body, or a selected target missing the required literal, never admits this target. The includes() marker is only a necessary preview-readiness condition: TEST stream partial complete also contains TEST stream partial. The unchanged explicit completion-absence, currentness and post-click assertions remain authoritative.

### Publish and test-first sequence
This prospective R1 and append-only Plan29 must be committed and immediately pushed, then independently read back in full from the actual published commit before authoring a test/runner/producer postimage.
After that gate, root may author only the additive test and a task-only runner derived from already reviewed41060e08824dcefab62500097da2289b98a732d3. Exact independent R2 must review complete postimages, input/path bindings, command vectors, full source-preservation census and new case census before any local application/execution. Publish the test commit with immediate exact-lease push and obtain complete actual readback before RED.
Run one whole-file RED against unchanged1e943/dcd0 producers. All78 existing cases must execute and pass; at least the new delayed-preview behavioral expectations must fail semantically. An import, compile, missing-export, setup, timeout, signal, skipped/cancelled or unreachable case does not satisfy RED. Independent review must accept complete raw/receipt/input/cleanup and the exact semantic RED before any producer postimage is authored or selected.
Then author the two producer postimages. Complete independent exact R2, immediate-push publication and actual full readback must precede application/GREEN. One whole-file GREEN and, only if genuine GREEN, the three scoped guards are allowed. Preserve every failed or unused attempt; no automatic retry or substitute command. Any expanded scope requires a new concrete R1.

### Required actual-source finite regressions
Exercise the real createDesktopUiControls/ui.click and its actual generated DOM expression in a finite VM DOM. Do not copy or replace the target/readPoint/click implementation.
Reproduce the retained coordinates exactly: the old original ownership check6 hydrates the selected target's reply and changes y178→186.5, after the old two stable samples and before final equality; old code must refuse before any pressed/released input. With requiredContent the same observation occurs within the original initial readPoint and the one eventual hover/press/release use y186.5. Assert physical input counts/order and retained owner checks; no extra sleeps, retries or fabricated labelled success.
Cover marker only in body/neighbor, duplicate matching rows with one ready, a different required marker never becoming ready, empty/missing/disabled/overlaid target controls using existing eligibility, literal escaping, marker removal at the final ownership check with unchanged coordinates, and unrelated movement/owner refusal despite marker presence. Preserve default-call regression behavior and the full original78-case census. Test actual openChat source forwarding with ordinary/lead member names and boot/partial data using baseline-compatible extraction of the existing helper; review all four real call sites in R2.
Use Reflect.apply (or an independently reviewed assignable optional-argument type) to pass the future fourth argument to the original three-argument click in RED, so there is no manufactured TypeScript arity failure. Clocks, DOM and CDP are finite seams; no actual GUI/provider/native runtime is started by additions. The original whole-file finite shell/TEST cases remain unchanged.

### Exact current inputs and runner scope
Fresh read-only inputeab37daec1b7cc8e979d023b037de9b9e41ccf08 records a complete rehash of all8798 selected current source rows,1504 compiled files,253+12 installed provider/SPI archive members and six tool files. They match published original GREEN c84039731095a0fc4884ce97dffc2da25330f267. Original base-index inventory5ac26325a57b11d171453857f6c5b5c8f24dd1cd (SHA69d471b52e0592b84e7b47c46e93dcc4a4b1a007e80c632cb11f9eee290dbb5e) remains the runner's HEAD47d9 index reference; overlays describe E plus only the current reviewed test/producers.
The fresh directory census additionally retains the existing2779-byte pnpm-generated node_modules/.bin/anthropic-ai-sdk wrapper, SHA12946d6ff9b003145072f82fd42c8c4c373ae2b0879a597db42657af15650428. It is outside the253 archive members, pinned as generated package metadata, and never executed. A prior read-only scan rejected the overly broad archive-only directory assumption; that was not a source/test/runtime attempt. No source/package byte is ignored, rewritten or admitted from local05c6.
Use exact Node24 /workspace/scratch/82d3f9ba6b85/toolchain/node24/bin/node,126595440bytes/SHA7fde7b8afa198da66257f42ee2001d874c7355631e6d1579a5fb5ef1f246df4c. Use the same already qualified app pnpm11.25 fallback/tool/config pins; this is not provider pnpm11.18 or CI pnpm11.22. No version invocation, build, install, compiler, real Claude/Codex (including version), native OpenCode or GUI invocation is allowed.
The derived runner is at most500 physical lines and preserves original source/dependency/tool pre/post checks, local-index/overlay/no-untracked/no-staged guards, attempt exclusivity, full raw capture, signal handlers and captured-group cleanup. Only change R1/subject/output bindings, the three source paths, whole-file test argv, the two GREEN materialization paths, and evidence/temp placement. A dedicated /tmp/c714-ui-conversation-evidence root and TMPDIR child directory keep TEST temp census task-local; do not alter HOME/CODEX_HOME, copy shared dependencies or remove another actor's files. Additionally verify the one generated wrapper and fresh-input identity. Preserve the prior negative controls and full1504/253+12/tool inventories before and after.
Before materialization verify at least8MiB workspace and64MiB task-filesystem headroom. Write only reviewed changed paths; any failure/drift is a retained refusal, not permission for repair/rebuild/alternate runtime. Data-only read/hash/archives and exclusive task directories are allowed; the executable runner requires exact R2 before execution. No local executable source has changed at R1 preparation.

### Five finite commands
RED1/1 and GREEN1/1 each: pinned Node24 --test scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-team-ui-smoke.test.ts, cwd existing reconciled app, outer180 seconds. No pattern/shard or omitted old case.
After accepted GREEN, lint1/1: pnpm lint:fast:files scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-ui-controls.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-emulated-selection-ui.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-team-ui-smoke.test.ts.
Source-size1/1: pnpm guard:source-file-size.
Diff-check1/1: git diff --check -- those exact three paths.
All three scoped guards retain the prior180-second outer bound and original underlying commands. No lint-fix or broad compiler retry.
Create each attempt record before spawn. Preserve full original output, input/census snapshots, actual exit/signal/timeout and captured process group/TEST temp cleanup. Existing outer-failure cleanup is confined to that actual captured group and reaps it; no broad name/PID kill or escaped-child proof. Killed/skipped/cancelled/unreached/unknown is never PASS. All prior unrelated exhausted budgets remain exhausted; dormant D diagnostic budgets are not transferred here.

### Later qualification and delivery
No PR metadata/ref change, rerun/cancel/dispatch, release, Ready, main/default merge or Stage2 is authorized here. Frozen PR1206/1207/1208/1211/1212/1213 remain unchanged. Own branch commits are immediately pushed with exact expected head/force=false in the same orchestration call with no intervening tool. Root alone authors/applies/executes; children are read-only reviewers/monitors.
A later original CI venue requires a separate concrete action R1 binding its exact resulting head/tree/base/body and complete unchanged workflow routes/range. It must not reuse the frozen E head or reinterpret E results as qualification of these new sources. Prefer a new exact baseE to keep the fresh range small; no CI action is selected now. Existing full workspace/typed renderer/native/platform gates and Windows Process15s/P08 separate10s/strictDarwin P09/genuineM16/P11 remain scoped to their own exact evidence.

def identity(data):
    return {'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
            'gitBlob': hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\0' + data).hexdigest()}


def utc():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=REPO)


def read_row(relative):
    path = REPO / relative
    info = path.lstat()
    if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):
        data, mode = os.readlink(path).encode(), '120000'
    else:
        assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode), relative
        data, mode = path.read_bytes(), '100755' if info.st_mode & stat.S_IXUSR else '100644'
    return {'path': relative, 'mode': mode, **identity(data)}


def process_rows():
    rows = []
    for item in pathlib.Path('/proc').iterdir():
        if not item.name.isdigit():
            continue
        try:
            raw = (item / 'stat').read_text()
            close = raw.rfind(')')
            tail = raw[close + 2:].split()
            rows.append({'pid': int(item.name), 'name': raw[raw.index('(') + 1:close],
                         'state': tail[0], 'ppid': int(tail[1]), 'pgid': int(tail[2]),
                         'session': int(tail[3]), 'startTicks': int(tail[19])})
        except FileNotFoundError:
            continue
    return sorted(rows, key=lambda row: row['pid'])


def temp_rows():
    rows = []
    for path in pathlib.Path(tempfile.gettempdir()).iterdir():
        if path.name.startswith('TEST-'):
            info = path.lstat()
            rows.append({'name': path.name, 'device': info.st_dev, 'inode': info.st_ino,
                         'mode': stat.S_IFMT(info.st_mode)})
    return sorted(rows, key=lambda row: row['name'])


def source_snapshot(overlays):
    assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == LOCAL_HEAD
    base = {row['path']: row for row in inventory['trackedNonDocRows']}
    expected = {**base, **{row['path']: {key: row[key] for key in ['path', 'mode', 'gitBlob', 'bytes', 'sha256']}
                          for row in overlays}}
    assert len(base) == len(expected) == 8798
    assert len({row['path'] for row in overlays}) == len(overlays)
    index = {}
    for raw in git('ls-files', '--stage', '-z').split(b'\0'):
        if not raw:
            continue
        metadata, path = raw.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, blob, stage = metadata.decode().split()
        assert stage == '0'
        name = path.decode()
        if not name.startswith('docs/'):
            index[name] = {'mode': mode, 'gitBlob': blob}
    assert set(index) == set(base)
    assert all(index[path] == {key: row[key] for key in ['mode', 'gitBlob']} for path, row in base.items())
    assert git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only', '-z') == b'', 'no staged changes'
    assert git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z') == b'', 'no unrelated untracked work'
    changed = {row['path'] for row in overlays if row['gitBlob'] != base[row['path']]['gitBlob']}
    actual_changed = {p.decode() for p in git('diff', '--name-only', '-z', 'HEAD').split(b'\0') if p}
    assert actual_changed == changed, sorted(actual_changed ^ changed)
    rows = [read_row(path) for path in sorted(expected)]
    for row in rows:
        assert row == expected[row['path']], 'source differs: ' + row['path']
    return {'actualLocalHead': LOCAL_HEAD, 'documentaryCheckout': LOCAL_HEAD,
            'publishedExecutableSource': cfg['publishedSubject'], 'rows': rows,
            'changedTrackedPaths': sorted(changed), 'status': git('status', '--porcelain').decode()}


def dependency_snapshot():
    compiled = []
    for root in inventory['compiledRoots']:
        for path in sorted((REPO / root).rglob('*')):
            assert not path.is_symlink(), 'unexpected compiled symlink: ' + str(path)
            if path.is_file():
                data = path.read_bytes()

    assert sorted(compiled, key=lambda row: row['path']) == sorted(inventory['compiledRows'], key=lambda row: row['path'])

    installed = []
    for pin in inventory['currentInstalledProviderVerification']:
        archive = REPO / pin['archive']
        archive_id = identity(archive.read_bytes())
        assert archive_id['bytes'] == pin['archiveBytes'] and archive_id['sha256'] == pin['archiveSha256']
        members = []
        with tarfile.open(archive, 'r:gz') as handle:

                    continue
                assert member.name.startswith('package/') and '..' not in pathlib.PurePosixPath(member.name).parts
                relative = member.name[len('package/'):]
                data = handle.extractfile(member).read()
                actual = pathlib.Path(pin['installedRoot']) / relative
                assert actual.is_file() and not actual.is_symlink() and actual.read_bytes() == data, relative
                members.append({'path': relative, **identity(data)})
        assert len(members) == pin['comparedFiles']
        installed.append({'package': pin['package'], 'archive': pin['archive'], 'archiveIdentity': archive_id,

    assert env.get('XDG_CONFIG_HOME', str(pathlib.Path.home() / '.config')) == cfg['configSearchRoots']['xdgConfig']
    for binding in cfg['inheritedConfigPathBindings']:
        values = [value for key, value in env.items() if key.lower() == binding['key']]
        assert values and all(value == binding['value'] for value in values), 'changed config search prefix'
        assert binding['key'] == 'npm_config_prefix'
        assert str(pathlib.Path(binding['value']) / 'etc/npmrc') == binding['absentConfig']
        assert binding['absentConfig'] in cfg['absentUserConfigs']
    return {'compiledRows': compiled, 'installedProviderArchives': installed,
            'directNode': {'path': NODE, **runtime}, 'toolingPins': tooling,
